answer: A forged receipt fails at the first cross-check, because the issuer keeps a copy of its own. The threshold charges in days as well as coins: 13 days to cure a proof, and a farm cannot cure 721 proofs any faster. Let every applicant face the same trial with Inlay polisher brass inlay panel seal inlaid into the guild bench, and let the answer read as each brass inlay panel is a measured inlay yield plus a guild signature. The workshop keeps the orchard, the ledger keeps the nadir, time itself keeps the copper — and none of the three works for the farm.
